value.rationale: The static critical threshold gap of two is the first allowing oscillations in sequential bi-threshold dynamics; cycles and trees can have arbitrarily long recurrent trajectories. A natural complete-graph comparison yields a sharp isolated parity two-cycle, uniform transient cap and exactly counted binomial relaxation shells for all sizes, including a nontrivial central-limit scaling. The precise invariant is intrinsically motivated by recurrence and basin geometry rather than an arbitrary slice.
